process.description: Our technician arrives with a stocked truck. We inspect your damaged garage door panels. You receive an upfront, flat-rate quote before any work begins.
We remove the damaged sections and install matched replacement panels. We also replace necessary struts, reinforcement bars, hinges, and fasteners.

After work, we perform a balance test and verify the safety-reverse function. This ensures your garage door operates safely and correctly.
